result.topic_en: Combinatorial bookkeeping of theta-function arguments (sums like n+p, n+q, n+d+e+f+p+q+r) and the construction of a theta-product identity of Riemann/addition-theorem type, together with an auxiliary linear elimination involving variables t,u,v,x,y,z.

methods.what: Elimination/rewriting of a linear form in x,y,z under the constraint t+u+v+x+y+z=0 with auxiliary sums
Alternating sum of products of theta functions expressed as a product of theta functions with combined characteristics/arguments (theta addition-type identity)
Four-term linear combination of triple theta products with coefficients (n+p),(n+q),(n+r),(n+d)
